script:
Hi everyone, hi everyone! Come in, come in! Don't be shy, my dears, join our big family here today! If you are just tapping into our live stream, a very warm welcome to you. I am your neighbor’s sister here, and I have some really good things to share with you today. Before we even start, look at that follow button at the top. Faster click follow now, okay? Because once you follow us, you can claim a one dollar voucher immediately! This one dollar is for you to use right now, but please remember, it is only valid for twenty-four hours. Don't let it expire, or else very wasteful, you know?

Today, I want to talk about something every single household in Singapore needs. Whether you have a big family or you stay alone, you definitely use this every day. I am talking about tissue paper! But not just any tissue paper, we are looking at the ROYO PANDA Soft Deluxe Facial Tissues from the Baby Monster Series. Look at the packaging, so cute right? My sisters, look at the price on your screen now. It is starting from only twelve dollars and ninety-nine cents for the smaller bundles, up to twenty-four dollars and ninety-nine cents for the massive jumbo sets. We have a special deal today for thirty-six packs! Yes, thirty-six packs! That is a lot of tissue, enough to last you a long, long time. If you see the price now, faster go to the orange basket and secure your order first, because these sets are moving very fast.

Let me ask you something. Have you ever been in a situation where you are sweating so much because of the hot Singapore weather, you take a piece of tissue to wipe your face, and then what happens? The tissue just breaks! It tears into tiny white pieces and sticks all over your forehead and your cheeks. So embarrassing, right? Or you try to wipe a small water spill on the dining table, and the tissue just dissolves into a wet mess. You end up needing five or six pieces just to clean one spot. That is because most tissues outside are only two-ply or three-ply. They are very thin and not strong at all. 

But look at what I have here. This ROYO PANDA tissue is five-ply! Yes, five layers of thickness in every single sheet. Can you imagine that? While other brands are giving you thin layers that tear easily, we are giving you five layers of premium strength. Each pack comes with two hundred and forty sheets, and the size is one hundred and forty by one hundred and seventy millimeters. It is just the right size to fit in your hand or your handbag. 

And for my fellow moms out there, I know what you are worried about. We always want the safest for our babies. Their skin is so thin and so delicate, we cannot just use any rough paper on them. Some tissues out there use recycled paper or they add a lot of bleach and fluorescent agents to make the paper look white. That is not good for sensitive skin, especially for newborns. But with ROYO PANDA, you can stay calm and worry-free. This is made from premium virgin bamboo pulp. It is naturally soft and very, very gentle. We do not add any bleach, and there are no fluorescent agents inside. It is completely safe for the whole family, from the oldest to the youngest.

Let me do a little demonstration for you, because seeing is believing, right? I have a bowl of water here. I am going to take one sheet of this ROYO PANDA tissue. Look, it feels so thick and substantial, not like those flimsy ones. I am putting it into the water now. I am letting it soak completely. Now, look at this. I am pulling it. Look at the strength! It does not just disintegrate or turn into mush. It is very durable even when it is wet. This means if you are outside and you don't have a wet wipe, you can just put a bit of water on this tissue and use it to wipe your hands or your face. It is strong enough to handle it! You can use it to wipe oil in the kitchen or water spills on the sofa, and it won't leave those annoying paper bits everywhere. 

The texture is also something I must tell you about. It is so soft, like a little cloud. When you rub it against your skin, it feels very smooth. It won't make your nose red even if you have a cold and you need to wipe your nose many times a day. For those of you who do your makeup every morning, this is excellent for your skincare routine too. Use it to pat your face dry after washing, it is much more hygienic than using a towel that has been hanging in the toilet for days. 

And look at the pull-out design. It is very smooth. When you pull one sheet, the next one stays tucked neatly inside. It doesn't all come out in a big clump, so it stays clean and hygienic. You can put one pack in your car, one in the office, one in the baby’s diaper bag, and one in every room of your house. Since you are getting thirty-six packs in this bundle, you really have enough to share with your parents or your siblings too.

Oh, I see some of you asking in the comments about the delivery. Don't worry, we pack them nicely and send them straight to your doorstep. No need for you to carry heavy boxes from the supermarket back to your HDB. We do the heavy lifting for you! And remember, this bundle is also a very practical idea for Teachers' Day gifts or as doorgifts for your child's birthday party. The Baby Monster design is so trendy and cute, everyone will love it.

Sisters, I need to give you a quick update. The system is showing me that we only have twenty-five sets left at this special introductory price. People are checking out very fast! I see Siti just bought two sets, and Mabel just grabbed one too. Thank you for the support, lah! If you have it in your cart, please go and pay now, because if you wait, the price might go back up or the stock might run out. This deal is really worth it for five-ply tissue. You are paying for quality and durability here. 

For those who just joined us, welcome! Don't forget to hit the follow button to get your one dollar voucher. We are talking about the ROYO PANDA five-ply tissues. It is skin-friendly, baby-safe, and very strong. No chemicals, no bleach, just pure bamboo pulp goodness. It is very hard to find five-ply tissues at this kind of price in the shops outside. Usually, five-ply is very expensive, but today we are giving you a massive bundle deal.

I really care about what you use for your family. I use this at home myself for my own kids, and I can tell you, it makes a big difference. No more sneezing from tissue dust, and no more wasting five sheets when one sheet can do the job. It is all about value for money. 

Let's look at the orange basket again. We are down to the last fifteen sets! If you are still thinking about it, don't wait anymore. Once these are gone, I don't know when the next batch will arrive. This is the premium series, the Soft Deluxe one. It is really the top choice for families who want safety and comfort. 

Let me show you the thickness again for those who missed it. Look at this sheet. Can you see the layers? One, two, three, four, five! It is thick but still feels very breathable and soft. When you use it to wipe a baby's mouth after they eat, you know it is gentle and won't scratch their skin. It is also very absorbent. If you spill some tea or coffee, just place one sheet over it, and it will soak up the liquid very quickly. 

My dears, we are in the final stages of this deal for today. Only ten sets left in the system! Ten, nine, eight... please check your carts! If you haven't checked out, do it now. I don't want you to be disappointed later when you see the 'sold out' sign. Seven, six, five... almost there! To those who have already purchased, thank you so much! You are going to love the quality when it arrives at your house. You will feel the difference the moment you touch it. 

If you are still hovering and haven't decided, just think about how much you spend on cheap tissue every month. You use so much more because they are thin. But with this five-ply ROYO PANDA, you use less, so it actually saves you money in the long run. Plus, the safety for your skin and your children's skin is something you cannot put a price on. 

Last five sets! The count is dropping! Five, four, three... quickly go to the orange basket! Two, one! Okay, I see the orders are still coming in. If you can still click it, that means there are a few more units left from people who didn't finish their payment. Try your luck now! 

I am so happy so many of you are getting this deal. It is really a household essential. Remember to use that one dollar voucher you got from following us! It makes the price even better. Keep an eye on your notifications for the delivery status. We will get these out to you as soon as possible so you can start enjoying the premium softness. 

For those who are still here, stay tuned, because we have more great items coming up. But really, this tissue deal is one of our highlights. Five layers of virgin bamboo pulp, no bleach, no fluorescents, and very strong even when wet. It is the reliable choice for every Singaporean home. Thank you everyone for being so active in the chat! I love your energy today! Let's keep it going! Grab your ROYO PANDA Baby Monster packs now and experience the deluxe feel for yourself!
